verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own release-oriented capabilities: tracking every deployment in real time to spot new errors or regressions (via the Deployments API) and segmenting errors by version. That gives a thin basis for per-release error comparison. However, nothing in the evidence shows release-health metrics like crash-free sessions or users, per-release adoption, or a canary-versus-stable comparison view. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, release adoption tracking, canary vs last-stable comparison, independent corroboration.
